title: Page 133
transc:
McCaine HF  Washn July 30th 1864 3 P. M. 
Grapes Laugh July Imogen For Mackerel unity Shelter Emory's
Polka of Penny Promise Pledge Publish Squash will leave
by Palmyra this after noon and evening for the
Moon ox Susy zebra His train with small Pacific
scout will go by the Fraid rick pike zodiac
Clendenins Panama has been ordered to Wolf whack Emitts
burg and send back Sutton zebra If the Welch
can assist Writes Tanner it should be used unity
Dovers Pacific should give more satisfactory account of Roses
Talbots stop If the Ridges Oyster Pocketed the Attica
yesterday morning it certainly should have been nicked here
earlier than this morning unity The walnut saint that
entered Chambers burg this morning does not seem to
have been over a promise pause nothing heard from
there since Yoke Italy Oh for a lodge woods
